loop.top3_why: The series exhibits a very strong upward trend and moderate seasonality, with model rankings unstable across the three validation windows. A robust, simple combination such as the plain mean of the full pool is less likely to overfit to the limited validation data and handles correlated errors well. The mean strategy shows consistent performance across windows (0.636, 0.691, 0.727) and its validation score is only slightly worse than the weighted alternative, while the weighted scheme risks high variance in weight estimation given only three windows.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (DBA) has a lower overall score and its per‑window performance is worse in the first two windows, indicating it may not capture the trend‑dominated dynamics as well. Candidate C (inverse‑error weighted) improves the second window but its first window matches the mean and the third window is identical; given the unstable ranking and correlated errors, the added complexity of weighting is not justified and may overfit the small validation set.
